method: One frozen production fixture, twelve alternating old/new 120-frame intervals in one rendered process; median of six interval statistics per style. Every interval checks exact full world/narrative serialization equality. First-build values use separate fresh Godot processes and exclude deferred GPU completion.
environment: Debian 13, Godot 4.6.1 .NET, GL Compatibility, llvmpipe LLVM 19.1.7, Xorg dummy loopback TCP, 1280x800 mobile layout, unchanged 1.5x zoom; no VSync. No other local test/build workload during the accepted comparison.
limits: Hosted software renderer, not physical Galaxy S25 or emulator performance.
p95 is median of per-interval p95 statistics, not pooled percentile.
Earlier independent-process prototypes varied widely and included regressions; all raw comparisons are retained.
Cold machine startup, GPU completion/timer-query attribution and process working set are not isolated.
No long-session memory claim. Counters include all game textures/buffers.
